From Ancient Greek ἐζευγμένον (ezeugménon), neuter nominative singular of ζευγμένος (zeugménos, “yoked, joined”), the perfect passive participle of ζεύγνυμι (zeúgnumi, “to yoke, join”).
After German physicist Gustav Anton Zeuner (1828-1907) in 1872.
